basic_info.description: Nestled in the vibrant Excelsior District, this newly renovated 3-bedroom,1.5-bathroom home offers 1,731 sqft of living space designed for comfort and convenience. Modern updates include a private bathroom, a full kitchen equipped with a range and refrigerator. The living room features extra storage, while the kitchen boasts a pantry, enhancing functionality. Step outside to a spacious deck that overlooks a beautifully landscaped backyard perfect for relaxation or entertaining. This property is less than a mile from the lush greenery of John McLaren Park and just half a mile from local restaurants. Commuters will love the quick access to Hwy 101 and Hwy 280, as well as the proximity to Balboa Park and Glen Park BART stations. Highly-rated schools, including Cleveland Elementary and Stratford Middle, are only minutes away, while Diamond Heights Shopping Center is a short 2.5-mile drive. Ideal for those seeking effortless travel to downtown San Francisco, the East Bay, or the Peninsula, this home is located in a sunny neighborhood with friendly neighbors and stunning Bay views. Don't miss this outstanding opportunity in the heart of San Francisco!
